title: Fits everything except the recurring-revenue rule (20% recurring)

input.facts: Lab automation systems for clinical laboratories, sold as capital equipment; service is only 20% of sales. The share price fell 30% after two large hospital-network orders were pushed from 2025 into 2026, both since confirmed. Leverage 1.5x. No holder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: The business-model rule is a warning only, never a reject: Priority, with a warning that recurring revenue is low. Not Radar.
